newsitem.title: USA: Trans World Airlines sets fare sale.
newsitem.headline: Trans World Airlines sets fare sale.

text.p: Trans World Airlines Inc said Thursday it set a summer fare sale throughout North America, with round-trip fares ranging from $198 to $348 depending on the distance flown.
For example, trips under 500 miles, such as St. Louis-Milwaukee, have a round-trip sale fare of $198. Trips of 500 to 999 miles, such as New York-St. Louis, have a fare of $238.

Trips of 1,000 to 1,499 miles, such as Atlanta-Denver, are priced at $258 roundtrip. A fare of $298 was set for trips of 1,500 to 1,999 miles, such as San Diego-St. Louis, $328 for trips of 2,000 to 2,499 miles like Seattle-Boston, and $348 for 2,500 to 2,999 miles, like New York-San Francisco.

TWA said all fares are non-refundable and are valid for travel between July 3 and November 16. Tickets must be purchased at least 14 days in advance and by midnight the day after reservations are made, but no later than June 27.
In most cases, a Saturday night stay is required and other restrictions apply.
